Do: (1) a real design language on the terminal ground and Tade colours just set: spacing scale and vertical rhythm, type scale and weights, alignment/centering rules (fix the squeezed-button case everywhere: controls get proper vertical padding, content is centred or deliberately aligned, no dead space), a colour-role system (what amber, green, red, dim, accent mean; when to highlight vs mute), elevation.
